Name: Hellebores
Author: LenoraRose
Description:
Hellebores are a flower that blooms in later Winter or early Spring, even in the real world. This Content Patcher mod adds 4 varieties as follows: 
[b]Blush-Pink Hellebore:[/b] A simple pretty flower, popular with many. 16 days to grow, and reblooms every 5 days. (Universal like, with select loves and few dislikes)
[b]Wine-Dark Hellebore:[/b] A burgundy flower, a bit more of an acquired taste as it has a very strong perfume. 16 days to grow and reblooms every 5 days. (Universal neutral, liked by many, surprisingly disliked by some)
[b]Ebony Hellebore:[/b] As well as blue-black flowers, this variety has a burst of variegated leaves at its base, and there are rumours it has magical properties. (Universal like, loved by the more magical characters)
[b]Purple Hellebore:[/b] A slightly faster growing variety, cheaper because rumours it was a Joja GMO have dented its reputation. But there are still some folks who love that shade. (Universal neutral with select likes and dislikes)

Seeds should be available at Pierre's shop.

[b]Compatibility:[/b] The only other mod I know of that lists hellebores is Quaint Living's Wildflowers, but should be compatible even with that, as the internal IDs will differ. the flowers should work with any machines added which effect flowers. Includes i18n files for the basics; translations welcome.

[b]Future Plans: [/b]
With this specific mod, none. This mod was the first one I made for myself in 1.5, to match with a specific farmer (Who I may redo as an NPC someday...) and upon redoing it in 1.6, I decided to share. It tried to balance it so it wasn't too profitable, but all feedback is welcome.
